item.title: Students who skip school could face new punishments, including loss of driver’s license
item.description: Students with too many unexcused absences would be barred from playing sports and could lose their driver's license under legislation approved by the state Senate Thursday.

item.title: Valdosta man sentenced to federal prison
item.description: A South Georgia man with prior drug convictions was sentenced to prison after police found him illegally in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop.

item.title: SGMC Interventional Physiatry recognized as Sonex Center of Excellence
item.description: SGMC Health announces that SGMC Interventional Physiatry under the leadership of Robert Kirtley, MD, has been recognized as a Center of Excellence by Sonex Health.

item.title: Southern Georgia Black Chambers launches Small Business Academy
item.description: The season for planning is officially over in South Georgia. On Tuesday evening, the Southern Georgia Black Chambers (SGBC) officially launched its 2026 Small Business Academy, drawing a crowd of 51 local entrepreneurs.
